notes: go test -count=1 ./internal/server/... green and go vet ./internal/server/... clean at the pinned head (ACTION-REVIEW-TEST-003/004). Spec-named tests for this chunk checked: TestBootstrapEnv, TestLoadPresentationProfile, TestPresentationStore_SaveProfileSelection/SaveStyle, TestServer_HandleProfileSave/StyleSave, TestNavCasual, TestOverviewCasual, TestReposCasualProjects / TestReposAddCasualForcesAdditionalDir / TestReposAddDeveloperUnchanged / TestReposAddWithLabel / TestReposAddInitsGit (spec-5 names renamed NonDeveloper->Casual), TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent, TestStatusCache / TestStatusCacheDropBranches / TestStatusCacheDelete, TestWorktreeStatusFragmentServesCache (fingerprint-change case present), TestRepoRemoveSelected (clean-removal-drops-cached-rows, skip-output-leaves-cache-untouched), TestProposalsGroupTitlesNonDeveloper/TooltipsGerman/DefaultEnglish, sessions_test archive/rescan cases all present. Remaining spec gaps (TestRoutineDetailRunHistory, i18n completeness, legacy non-developer, .git-untouched, cross-instance delete, de template seeding) are already in the known ledger and not re-reported. spec-8 repos_test reserved name 'archived' is exercised only at the registry layer (internal/repos/registry_test.go reserved-name-fails) — not reported. Cross-chunk: skills_analytics_test.go adds a nested eval-run artifact test whose production partner (skills analytics loader) lies outside this chunk; not verified here.

findings.claim: No test proves a Profile-page save takes effect on rendered pages without a restart: the t/langAttr/isDeveloperAudience template funcs now read presentationStore live (spec-12 D3, the comment at server.go:161-162), but no test POSTs /profile and then GETs a page. Reverting the funcs to a New()-time snapshot (e.g. lang := presentation.language() captured once) keeps the whole suite green while a casual/de save keeps rendering the English developer nav until restart.
findings.evidence: Re-read server.go:159-169 (t, langAttr, isDeveloperAudience bound to presentation methods) and presentation.go:69-80/88-112 (saveProfileSelection -> reload swaps st.profile). git grep for '"/profile"' and saveProfileSelection across *_test.go: profilesettings_test.go:32 (GET /profile only), :154 (POST /profile asserting status, file presence and presentation.isDevMode()), presentation_test.go:355 (store-level, asserts store.language()). No test renders a template after a save, so the live-read wiring at the template layer is unasserted. Not in the known ledger (tests-NIT-66-r1 is the /profile form binding from a stored profile, a different path).
findings.fix: Add a profilesettings_test case: newTestServer with a temp PresentationPath, POST /profile {audience: casual, language: de}, then GET / and assert body contains `lang="de"` and `>Übersicht` and lacks `href="/context"`.

findings.claim: The routine row's new Unscheduled branch — 'not scheduled' schedule cell (line 28) and data-reschedule="1" on the select radio (line 14) that enables Reschedule for a plist without StartCalendarInterval — has no server test; deleting either {{else if .Routine.Unscheduled}} arm keeps the suite green and silently reverts the row to 'unsupported schedule' with Reschedule disabled.
findings.evidence: Re-read _routine_row.html:11-14 and 25-29 against the base diff (both arms added in this range). git grep for 'not scheduled', 'Unscheduled' over *_test.go hits only internal/routines/plist_test.go:68-89/196 and routines_test.go:64-90, which assert the parsed Unscheduled flag, not the rendered row; no internal/server test renders /routines or /routines/{name} for an unscheduled routine (git ls-files internal/server shows no routines_test.go at all). No spec in round-1 mentions the unscheduled row, so this is an untested behavior change, not a spec gap.
findings.fix: Add internal/server/routines_test.go rendering the row template directly (server.tmpl.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, tmplRoutineRow, routineView{Routine: routines.Routine{Name: "x", Unscheduled: true}})) — no launchctl needed — and assert 'not scheduled' and data-reschedule="1"; a ScheduleSupported=false, Unscheduled=false view still renders 'unsupported schedule' without data-reschedule.
